name: combly
description: Comment export MCP server by Combly: export YouTube, TikTok and Instagram comments to CSV, search comments and pick fair giveaway winners.
long_description: Comment export, comment search and a giveaway winner picker for YouTube, TikTok and Instagram posts: export comments to CSV, find what viewers ask and draw fair giveaway winners. get_account reads your plan and usage. load_comments and search_comments read a post's comments and find them by keyword, author, date, questions or links; export_comments returns CSV. draw_giveaway picks random winners under your rules and publishes a winner page; list_giveaways and get_giveaway read past draws. Loads and draws use your plan's limits: every call runs on a Combly account, and a free account includes 5 post loads and 2 giveaway draws, once, no card; subscribe for more (paid plans count per month).
